summary: Frontend-only testing of new Broadband Business page (/services/broadband-business). All 11 feature-level checks requested in the review passed: homepage regression OK, services dropdown contains 'Broadband Business' link with correct testid, all 11 sections render with correct data-testids (bb-hero..bb-faq + site-footer), package tab Hospitality is default-active with all 5 cards HS-1..HS-5 showing correct prices (Rp 6.000.000 / 9.500.000 / 12.500.000 / 17.500.000 / 25.000.000), Business and Custom tabs show bb-consult-business / bb-consult-custom, quote buttons open contact-modal with service pre-filled to 'Broadband Internet', submitting the form shows success toast 'Message sent. Our team will reach out shortly.' and closes modal, FAQ accordion triggers 0..3 expand their content panels, EN->ID toggle switches hero to 'Internet Cepat & Andal untuk Bisnis Anda' plus breadcrumb to Beranda/Layanan and buttons to Minta Penawaran/Unduh Brosur, all 6 broadband images return HTTP 200 (hero.png, hospitality.png, technician.png, industries.webp, map.png, skyline.webp), mobile 390px has NO horizontal overflow (scrollWidth=clientWidth=390), mobile menu button opens and shows mobile-nav-link-broadband. No console / page errors except harmless Lenis position warnings.

design_issues.screen: Mobile menu (390px) overlay on broadband page
issues: Primary nav links (Home, Company, Services, Network, Industries, Contact) and the nested 'Broadband Business' sub-link render in very light gray on a nearly-white/blurred background giving extremely low contrast — text is barely readable. Consider darker ink color or stronger backdrop.

action_items: Improve mobile menu text contrast on broadband page (and likely all non-home pages) — current light-gray on light blurred background fails readability.
Optional: add data-testid='header-nav-services' to the Services dropdown trigger button for easier automation (dropdown item testid is already present and works).
critical_code_review_comments: Everything requested in the spec is wired up correctly: routing (/services/broadband-business), language context propagation (EN/ID), openContact('Broadband Internet') pre-fill, data-testids on every interactive/informational element, and image paths under /broadband/.
Package tab for Business/Custom correctly avoids inventing prices and shows a consultation CTA (bb-consult-business / bb-consult-custom) as instructed.
Form submission to /api/contact works end-to-end (success toast rendered).
Minor: mobile menu readability issue noted under design_issues is the only visible concern.
seed_data_creation: None. Submitted a single TEST contact message (name 'TEST User', company 'TEST Co', email test@test.com) via the live contact form to verify integration.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Broadband Business page is fully functional. Only outstanding item is a design/contrast fix for the mobile menu overlay on non-home pages. The lang-option-id / lang-option-en testids exist twice (header + footer) — use scoped selectors like [data-testid="header-lang-toggle"] [data-testid="lang-option-id"]. The contact modal uses a native <select> for service; its first <select> inside [data-testid="contact-modal"] holds the pre-filled value 'Broadband Internet'.
